meta.description: Faa miito ya kemonokei konbenshon de, hajimete no hito ga atarashii tomodachi wo tsukureru basho. Guroobaru/Faarii/terebijon ga otodoke shimasu.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.domain-heading: GFTV no koushiki saito wa globalfurry.tv mata wa gftv.asia de owarimasu
official.domain-body: Adoresu wa matsubi kara yomimasu. Saisho no tandoku no surasshu no chokuzen ni aru, saigo no dotto no bubun wo mite kudasai. Sore igai de owaru saito wa, adoresu no mae no hou ni namae ga fukumarete ite mo GFTV de wa arimasen.
official.secure-heading: Anzen na saito wa HTTPS wo tsukatte imasu
official.secure-body: Kagi no aikon, mata wa adoresu sentou no https:// wo kakunin shite kudasai. Kojin jouhou wa, anzen na setsuzoku no koushiki saito de nomi kyouyuu shimashou.
update.label: Appudeeto
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot no atarashii baajon ga riyou dekimasu.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot no neemu kaado. GFTV no nijiiro no sutoraipu no ue, ookina egao no yoko ni Hello to kou? To kakarete imasu.
hero.title: HelloSpot wo mitsuketa ne!
hero.lede: Faa miito ya kemonokei konbenshon de, HelloSpot wa hajimete no hito ga atarashii tomodachi wo tsukureru basho desu.
how.title: HelloSpot no tanoshimikata
how.spot.title: Sumairu wo mitsukeyou
how.spot.body: Kaado, nekku sutorappu, kanban no HelloSmile wo sagashite kudasai. Sore ga aru basho ga HelloSpot desu.
how.hello.title: Aisatsu shiyou
how.hello.body: Kigaru ni kite, aisatsu shite kudasai. HelloSpot de wa, mada shiriai ga inakute mo daijoubu desu.
how.friend.title: Tomodachi wo tsukurou
how.friend.body: Mawari no hito to shiriatte, tsugi no miito de aitai hito wo mitsukete kaerimashou.
gallery.eyebrow: Kore made no miito kara, konnichiha
gallery.title: HelloSpot de dekita tomodachi
takagi.when.title: Takagi itsu?
takagi.when.body: Dono miito mo, saigo wa kono shitsumon de owaru.

about.title: Guroobaru/Faarii/terebijon
about.body-1: Guroobaru/Faarii/terebijon (GFTV) wa, Shingapooru wo kyoten to suru Ajia saidai no kemono/Faarii fan damu no nyuusu channeru desu.
about.body-2: Watashitachi wa, kyou mo asu mo dare mo ga tanoshimeru you ni Faarii bunka no seichou wo shoukai shi, hitobito ga tagai wo shiri, rikai shi aeru ba wo tsukutte imasu.
about.body-3: Kyoten kara shuyou na tairiku e to hirogaru GFTV no chiimu wa, kokusaiteki de, tabunka de, tagengo desu.
outro.title: Tsugi no HelloSpot de aou ne!
